svg.text: A BAG OF PARTS, OR ONE PART DOING SEVERAL JOBS
each part does one job, and they are bolted together
four parts · four jobs · three joints to fail
one part serves several functions at once
one motor · four jobs · the hand never leaves it
The right-hand part wears the Haptic Handwheel's own avatar: the palace's worked case of Simondon's idea.
